# TalkWeave

> Tutorial de rede neural full-duplex em português, CPU primeiro.

## Start
- [Agent entry point](https://sorputi.github.io/talkweave/agents/): Readable HTML, no JavaScript required.
- [Execution guide](https://sorputi.github.io/talkweave/agents/guide.md): Steps, commands, verification and documentation.
- [Structured plan](https://sorputi.github.io/talkweave/agents/plan.json): Dependencies, files and hashes.
- [Full reference](https://sorputi.github.io/talkweave/llms-full.txt): Guide plus complete tutorial.

Respect the current site access policy. If login is required, use authorized access only.
